title: Bracket Balance
commonMistakes: Popping from an empty stack when a closing bracket appears first
Forgetting to check that the stack is empty after the loop
Matching bracket types without checking that the most recent opener matches
followUps: How would you return the position of the first mismatched bracket?
What changes if the string can contain non-bracket characters?
How would you handle angle brackets as a fourth pair?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
